comment: Independent detect.c witness for map_monst()'s tail: in debug mode a Samurai wishes for an uncursed potion of monster detection, creates a long worm whose makemon() initworm() gave it a tail, searches briefly and drinks the potion. monster_detect() calls map_monst(mtmp, TRUE), which shows the worm and then calls worm.c detect_wsegs() to draw each tail segment as '~' on the detection map.
